title: The Song of the Ark · author’s simplified outline
author: James Earle Patrick
sourceLocator: Appendix (10), p. 300 (PDF p. 314); author’s simplified 11-element rendering
note: This is the author’s separately printed 11-element simplified rendering of the same Song of the Ark proposal, not a second independent discovery. Keep it separate from the full 41-element outline: the source gives some different boundaries. In particular D ends at 1 Samuel 18:12 while E starts at 18:10; B′ ends at 2 Samuel 5:3 and A′ starts at 5:4, although the detailed outline places its corresponding division after 5:5. Those published overlaps and differences are preserved. Whole chapters are expanded to numbered-verse reading context using the loaded English edition. F is identified as the central episode in the thesis’s chapter 3 discussion, as well as occupying the unmatched middle position of this diagram. Complete source outline. Reading alignment: verified; 0 of 11 elements currently lack a verified complete reading-edition mapping. Unmapped source coordinates never enter reader discovery.

groups.label: A
groups.title: The ark’s earlier exile and dishonor are answered by its arrival in Jerusalem. Victories over Philistines and the governing homes of Samuel and David also frame the source’s simplified account.
